title: SharePoint bulk access
analyst_notes: User performing quarterly audit of financial documents. Approved by manager.

title: Port scan from external
analyst_notes: Routine internet scanner (Shodan). No action required.

title: Unusual AWS API calls
analyst_notes: New deployment pipeline testing. Approved change ticket CHG-2026-0445.

title: Service account anomaly
analyst_notes: Unauthorized use of backup service account by former contractor. Account disabled. Investigation ongoing.

title: Suspicious macro attachment
analyst_notes: Macro-enabled document from external party. File quarantined. User trained. No execution detected.

title: Email to personal account
analyst_notes: HR documentation forwarded to personal email. HR and Legal notified. Resignation submitted 3 days later.

title: Lateral movement attempt

title: USB device connected
analyst_notes: Authorized USB keyboard. Vendor ID confirmed. No data transfer detected.

title: Ransomware behavior
analyst_notes: MAJOR INCIDENT INC-2026-112: Ransomware on HR workstation. 12000 files encrypted. Isolated. Restored from backup. CVE-2024-21334.

title: MFA bypass attempt
analyst_notes: CFO confirmed travel to NYC. Login from hotel network matches confirmed travel itinerary.

title: S3 public access attempt
analyst_notes: Misconfigured terraform attempted to set public ACL on staging bucket. Script corrected. No data exposed.

title: C2 beacon to Cobalt Strike server
analyst_notes: WKSTN-FIN-042 beaconing to known CS infrastructure. Host isolated. Memory forensics initiated. Phishing email root cause confirmed.

title: Marketing newsletter flagged
analyst_notes: Legitimate vendor newsletter from Salesforce Marketing Cloud. Sender verified. Allow-listed.

title: Credential stuffing - 312 attempts
analyst_notes: Credential stuffing from known botnet IP. 4 accounts compromised. Passwords reset. MFA enforced on all finance accounts.

title: IP theft - source code exfil
analyst_notes: Developer uploaded proprietary trading algorithm source to personal GitHub. Repo made private. Legal hold placed. HR involved.

title: False malware detection
analyst_notes: CrowdStrike false positive on legitimate Python interpreter. Exclusion added after validation. Vendor case filed.

title: S3 bucket world-readable
analyst_notes: Production S3 bucket exposed publicly for 14 minutes via misconfigured IaC template. 0 external accesses logged. Bucket locked. Dev notified.

title: VPN split-tunnel false trigger
analyst_notes: VPN split-tunnel routing caused legitimate traffic to appear as suspicious bypass. Policy updated.

title: Account takeover - finance manager
analyst_notes: Finance manager account fully compromised. Attacker changed MFA device. 3 fraudulent wire transfers totalling $182k initiated - all blocked. INCIDENT INC-2026-003.

title: Bulk marketing email
analyst_notes: User subscribed to legitimate financial newsletter. Added to approved senders list.

title: Lateral movement - RDP chain
analyst_notes: Attacker pivoting via RDP from DMZ host through 4 internal systems. All affected hosts isolated. Forensic images taken.

title: AWS config rule change
analyst_notes: Authorized security team hardening activity. Change request CHG-2026-0112 verified.

title: Formbook infostealer
analyst_notes: Formbook variant detected stealing browser credentials and keystrokes. Host quarantined. All credentials rotated. 47 passwords harvested estimated.

title: Authorized bulk export
analyst_notes: Year-end audit data export authorized by CFO. Ticket AUTH-2026-0089 confirmed.

title: MFA token sync issue
analyst_notes: MFA authentication failures due to time drift on authenticator app. User re-enrolled. No malicious activity.

title: Spear phishing - wire fraud
analyst_notes: AP manager targeted with convincing BEC email. Malicious link clicked. Credentials entered on phishing page. Password reset. $0 financial impact.

title: Large data exfiltration via SFTP
analyst_notes: Database server exfiltrating 11 GB customer PII to Russia-based IP. Connection severed. DB server isolated. Breach notification initiated. INCIDENT INC-2026-031.

title: AV false positive - dev tool
analyst_notes: CrowdStrike flagged Metasploit framework used for authorized pen test. Exclusion added for approved test window.

title: Privilege escalation in Azure
analyst_notes: Compromised service principal used to assign Global Admin role. External attacker gained tenant-wide access for 23 minutes. All tokens revoked.

title: Impossible travel - sales director
analyst_notes: Account accessed from Philippines 8 minutes after Charlotte login. Account suspended. Confirmed breach. Forensics ongoing.

title: Vendor notification email
analyst_notes: Legitimate payment notification from Stripe. Sender domain verified. DLP policy tuned to reduce FP on payment processors.

title: Automated vulnerability scanner
analyst_notes: Shodan / Censys automated scan. Source IP confirmed as research scanner. No action required.

title: Bulk customer data download
analyst_notes: Departing employee downloaded 3,400 customer records 2 days before last day. HR escalated. Legal hold. Forensic copy obtained.

title: Pre-ransomware staging detected
analyst_notes: Cobalt Strike beacon followed by credential harvesting and shadow copy deletion. Contained before encryption. 3 hosts reimaged. INC-2026-067.

title: CI/CD pipeline new deployment
analyst_notes: Automated deployment of approved release v2.4.1. Change ticket CHG-2026-0389 confirmed.

title: Service account login spike
analyst_notes: Monthly backup job caused expected spike in service account authentication events. Tuned detection threshold.

title: Credential phishing link clicked - finance analyst
analyst_notes: jsmith clicked link in credential phishing email impersonating Workday HR portal. Credentials entered on phishing page. Password reset and MFA re-enrolled. No account takeover confirmed.

title: Vendor invoice fraud attempt - AP manager
analyst_notes: Convincing vendor impersonation email targeted AP manager with fraudulent ACH change request. Email blocked before action taken. Vendor relationship verified. Sender domain added to blocklist.

title: Sensitive salary data accessed outside hours
analyst_notes: Finance analyst accessed compensation reports at 11PM outside approved hours. HR notified given active PIP status. Access logged and reviewed by manager. No exfiltration detected.

title: Executive account login from overseas IP
analyst_notes: CFO account accessed from Amsterdam IP 4 hours after Charlotte login. Travel not confirmed by EA. Session terminated. Account suspended pending verification. User confirmed account compromise - password reset and MFA re-enrolled.

title: Unapproved remote access tool installed
analyst_notes: Marketing user installed AnyDesk without IT approval. Remote access tool removed. User counseled on software installation policy. No external connections logged.

title: Session token hijacked via AiTM phishing
analyst_notes: Advanced AiTM phishing captured jsmith session token. Attacker accessed email and SharePoint for 18 minutes before detection. All tokens revoked. Email audit completed - no sensitive data forwarded. INC-2026-058.

title: Financial model emailed to personal account
analyst_notes: AP manager forwarded Q1 variance model to personal Gmail for weekend review. Policy violation documented. Manager notified. Confirmed accidental - no malicious intent. User completed DLP training.

title: Spear phishing targeting accounts payable
analyst_notes: Highly targeted BEC email impersonating CFO requesting urgent wire transfer of $89k. AP specialist escalated to manager before acting. Email forensics confirmed spoofed domain. Sender blocked.

title: Keylogger detected on finance workstation
analyst_notes: Commercial keylogger (Spyrix) found on sjohnson workstation - installed via macro in received document. Keylogger removed. Browser credentials rotated. Workstation reimaged. INC-2026-071.

title: After-hours VPN access from new location
analyst_notes: VPN login from Charlotte residential ISP at 11PM. User confirmed working late on month-end close reports. IP verified as residential. Manager approved overtime.

title: Impossible travel - repeated attempt
analyst_notes: Second impossible travel alert for CFO this month. Login from Lagos Nigeria 6 minutes after Charlotte office badge-in. Account suspended. Forensics confirmed credential reuse from HIST-044 breach. All sessions revoked. INC-2026-079.

title: USB storage connected - marketing workstation
analyst_notes: Personal USB drive connected and 340MB transferred in 4 minutes. Files identified as marketing campaign assets - not sensitive. Policy violation documented. USB devices now blocked on WKSTN-MKTG-007.

title: Credential stuffing - AP manager account
analyst_notes: Automated credential stuffing attack targeted mchen account. 847 attempts from rotating IPs over 2 hours. 1 successful login detected before MFA blocked further access. Password reset. Geo-blocking applied to high-risk regions. INC-2026-091.

title: Source code pushed to public repository
analyst_notes: DevOps engineer accidentally pushed internal API keys and configuration files to public GitHub repo. Repo made private within 8 minutes of detection. Keys rotated. Secrets scanner added to CI pipeline.

title: Phishing simulation - low click rate
analyst_notes: Monthly internal phishing simulation. CFO did not click. Awareness training reinforced. No action required.
